page: Google Cloud Platform e2-highmem-2 is an x86_64 architecture instance belonging to the E2 family. It features 2 vCPUs mapped to 1 physical Intel Xeon core running at 2.2 GHz, with hyper-threading enabled. The instance is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware.

Performance benchmarks place this instance in the lower tiers for compute-heavy tasks. The stress-ng single-core CPU performance score is 1101.98, and the multi-core score is 1451.88, both falling into the bottom 25% and 10% respectively. Memory bandwidth tests show 80.53 GB/sec for small cached blocks and 12.0 GB/sec for large uncached blocks. Passmark CPU and memory scores are 3028.15 and 1468.27, reflecting weak to poor overall throughput.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the e2-highmem-2 offers a low-cost entry point for workloads requiring a larger memory footprint relative to compute power. Given the poor performance in high-throughput database operations and static web serving, this instance is best suited for lightweight, memory-sensitive applications, small-scale caching, development environments, or basic background utility tasks that do not demand intensive CPU cycles.
